summary.text: Shelby Labs is a Republican state representative from Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 143 who has served since December 1, 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Shelby Labs was born and lives in Plumsteadville, Pennsylvania.
She graduated from Central Bucks High School West and earned a degree from Temple University.
Labs assumed office on December 1, 2020, succeeding Wendy Ullman.
For the 2023-2024 session, Ballotpedia lists her committee assignments as Aging & Older Adult Services, Game & Fisheries, and Transportation, where she was subcommittee chair on Ports.
